worked_solution:
Recall that for any random variable $X$ and constants $a$ and $b,$ we have

$$
\text{Var}[aX+b]={a}^{2}\cdot \text{Var}[X].
$$

In our case, $a=4$ and $b=3.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[4X+3] & ={4}^{2}\cdot \text{Var}[X] \\  & =16\cdot 8 \\  & =128.\end{aligned}
$$
